(noun). trình tự, nghi thức

Ex: Coffee and the newspaper are part of my morning ritual.

switch

(verb). đổi

Ex: I decided to switch my focus from swimming to cycling.

virtual

(adjective). ảo

Ex: You can also take a virtual tour of the museum.

domestic

(adjective). thuộc về gia đình

Ex: The vast majority of paid and unpaid domestic workers are women. Ex: domestic violence

laundry

(noun). Việc giặt ủi

Ex: Have you done the laundry yet

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

sweep

(verb). quét dọn

Ex: Chimneys should be swept regularly.

multitask

(verb). đa nhiệm, làm nhiều việc cùng một lúc

Ex: Women seem to be able to multitask better than men.

attention span

(noun). sức tập trung

Ex: Small children have a very short attention span.

concentration

(noun). sự tập trung

Ex: Tiredness affects your powers of concentration.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

run out of

(verb). cạn, hết

Ex: We're running out of time - the report has to be ready for the meeting tonight.

suffer

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The company suffered huge losses in the last financial year.

distraction

(noun). sự làm xao nhãng

Ex: The TV provided a distraction from his work.

task

(noun). công việc

Ex: The first task for the new leader is to focus on the economy.

efficient

(adjective). Hiệu quả

Ex: We offer a fast, friendly and efficient service.

workplace

(noun). nơi làm việc

Ex: We must meet safety standards in the workplace

ban

(verb). Cấm đoán

Ex: The law effectively bans smoking in all public places.

certain

(adjective). nhất định, nào đó

Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

common

(adjective). chung, phổ biến

Ex:They share a common interest in photography.

practical

(adjective). Thực tiễn

Ex: He offered her some practical advice.

accurate

(adjective). Chính xác

Ex: Accurate measurements are essential.

flexible

(adjective). linh hoạt

Ex: Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater for the needs of everyone.

relate

(verb). liên hệ, liên kết

Ex: I found it difficult to relate the two ideas in my mind.

species

(noun). giống loài

Ex: Most of the known rhino species are West African.

vary

(verb). Thay đổi, khác nhau

Ex: The students' work varies considerably in quality.

control

(verb). điều khiển

Ex: Most of the symptoms can be controlled with medication.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

Ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

accomplish

(verb). đạt được

Ex: The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

attach

(verb). gắn vào, đính kèm

Ex: I attach a copy of my notes for your information.

concentrate

(verb). Tập trung

Ex: We're concentrating even harder on giving quality service this year.

electric

(adjective). chạy bằng điện

Ex: an electric car/vehicle Ex: Tesla is an American electric vehicle and clean energy company based in California.

experiment

(noun). thử nghiệm, thí nghiệm

Ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

mimic

(verb). sao chép, nhái

Ex: She's always mimicking the teachers.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

sensor

(noun). Thiết bị cảm biến

Ex: The security device has a heat sensor which detects the presence of people and animals.

stimulant

(noun). Chất kích thích

Ex: Coffee and tea are mild stimulants.

visual

(adjective). trực quan, thuộc thị giác

Ex: The rooms do not have much visual interest.

simultaneously

(adverb). Đồng thời

Ex: The game will be broadcast simultaneously on TV and radio.

actually

(adverb). thực sự

Ex: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.

sacrifice

(verb). hy sinh

Ex: Would you sacrifice a football game to go out with a girl?

efficiency

(noun). Hiệu quả, năng suất

Ex: I was impressed by the efficiency with which she handled the crisis.

divide

(verb). Phân chia

Ex: The questions divide into two categories: easy and hard.

efficiently

(adverb). một cách có năng suất

Ex: Resources must be used efficiently to avoid waste.

focus

(noun). Trọng tâm, sự tập trung

Ex: Education is the current focus of public debate.

multiple

(adjective). nhiều

Ex: The shape appears multiple times within each painting.

comfortable

(adjective). thoải mái

Ex: Please make yourself comfortable while I get some coffee.

nature

(noun). bản chất

Ex: His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.

dramatic

(adjective). kịch tính

Ex: There has been a dramatic rise in reported crime.

minor

(adjective). Nhỏ lẻ, không quan trọng

Ex: There may be some minor changes to the schedule.

phenomenon

(noun). hiện tượng

Ex: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.

refer to

(verb). đề cập, nhắc đến

Ex: The victims were not referred to by name.

surrounding

(noun). không gian xung quanh

Ex: The buildings have been designed to blend in with their surroundings.

term

(noun). thuật ngữ

Ex: What is the meaning of the term ‘globalization’?

study

(verb). Nghiên cứu

Ex: We will study the report carefully before making a decision.

solution

(noun). Giải pháp

Ex: Attempts to find a solution have failed.

sections.title: Passage 3: Improving Patient Safety
sections.html:
adopt

(verb). Thông qua, lựa chọn

Ex: All three teams adopted different approaches to the problem.

approach

(verb). tiếp cận

Ex: He approached the task in a very mature and systematic way.

attribute

(verb). cho là do, quy cho

Ex: He attributes his success to hard work and a little luck.

available

(adjective). có sẵn

Ex: We'll send you a copy as soon as it becomes available.

basis

(noun). Nền tảng

Ex: The basis of a good marriage is trust.

blame

(noun). lỗi, trách nhiệm

Ex: Why do I always get the blame for everything that goes wrong?

characteristic

(noun). Bản chất; Đặc trưng

Ex: All human languages share some common characteristics.

cognitive

(adjective). Liên quan đến nhận thức

Ex: They are studying the links between cognitive and linguistic development in young children.

compliance

(noun). sự tuân thủ

Ex: Safety measures were carried out in compliance with paragraph 6 of the building regulations.

comprehensibility

(noun). tính có thể lĩnh hội được

Ex: Comprehensibility refers to whether listeners can understand the message communicated by a speaker.

concern

(verb). liên quan đến

Ex: Please pay attention because this information concerns all of you.

consultant

(noun). Người tư vấn

Ex: He was happy to act as a consultant to the company.

contribute

(verb). đóng góp

Ex: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.

current

(adjective). hiện tại

Ex: Oil prices are expected to remain at current levels.

differentiation

(noun). Phân biệt

Ex: There needs to be a clear differentiation between communal and private areas of the house.

dismayed

(adjective). mất tinh thần

Ex: He was dismayed at the change in his old friend.

distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

Ex: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?

distribution

(noun). sự phân bổ

Ex: They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

exhibition

(noun). Triển lãm

Ex: The gallery is hosting an exhibition of his work.

feature

(noun). đặc tính

Ex: Teamwork is a key feature of the training programme.

inclusive

(adjective). toàn bộ

Ex: The party must adopt more inclusive strategies and a broader vision.

inject

(verb). tiêm, tiêm thuốc

Ex: Adrenaline was injected into the muscle.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

investigation

(noun). Cuộc điều tra

Ex: Officials are calling for an investigation into the incident.

legibility

(noun). sự dễ đọc

Ex: Among the changes we recommend are the removal of unnecessary text from labels, greater legibility, the use of larger print, and less glaring colours.

legislation

(noun). Pháp luật

Ex: They are calling for tough legislation to tackle this problem.

mandatory

(adjective). bắt buộc

Ex: It is mandatory for blood banks to test all donated blood for the virus.

modify

(verb). Điều chỉnh

Ex: Patients are taught how to modify their diet.

multitude

(noun). rất nhiều

Ex: These elements can be combined in a multitude of different ways.

pharmacy

(noun). dược học

Ex: She studied pharmacy before she got a job with a big chain store.

prominent

(adjective). nổi bật

Ex: The church tower was a prominent feature in the landscape.

publish

(verb). công bố

Ex: He works for a company that publishes reference books.

recommend

(verb). gợi ý, giới thiệu

Ex: I recommend the book to all my students.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

stimulate

(verb). Kích thích

Ex: The article can be used to stimulate discussion among students.

tragedy

(noun). bi kịch

Ex: Investigators are searching the wreckage of the plane to try to find the cause of the tragedy.

access

(noun). sự tiếp cận

Ex: They are seeking increased access to markets overseas.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

disability

(noun). Khuyết tật

Ex: No one knows what causes learning disabilities.

elderly

(adjective). Lớn tuổi

ex: elderly relatives/parents

freelance

(adverb). hành nghề tự do

Ex: She continued to work for the company on a freelance basis.

in terms of

(adverb). về, đối với

Ex: The job is great in terms of salary, but it has its disadvantages.

necessarily

(adverb). nhất thiết

Ex: Servants necessarily had close contact with their employers.

prevent

(verb). ngăn chặn

Ex: The government took steps to prevent a scandal.

according to

(preposition). theo

Ex: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.

container

(noun). vật chứa

Ex: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.

legal

(adjective). thuộc về pháp luật, hợp pháp

Ex: They are currently facing a long legal battle in the US courts.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

strength

(noun). Sức mạnh, sức lực, sức khoẻ

Ex: It may take a few weeks for you to build up your strength again.

arthritis

(noun). viêm khớp

Ex: In later life she was crippled with arthritis.

adapt

(verb). điều chỉnh, thích nghi

Ex: These styles can be adapted to suit individual tastes.

blind

(noun). người khiếm thị

Ex: The agency provides assistance to the blind.

impaired

(adjective). suy yếu, hư hại

Ex: She suffers from impaired vision.

sighted

(adjective). Có thể nhìn thấy; không mù

Ex: Guide dogs open up the lives of the blind or visually impaired.

visually

(adverb). về thị giác

Ex: Guide dogs open up the lives of the blind or visually impaired.

packaging

(noun). bao bì

Ex: Attractive packaging can help to sell products.

accidentally

(adverb). tình cờ

Ex: The damage couldn't have been caused accidentally.

admit

(verb). thừa nhận

Ex: She admitted making a mistake.

eliminate

(verb). loại bỏ

Ex: This diet claims to eliminate toxins from the body.

incident

(noun). Sự việc

Ex: He came to regret the whole incident.

pill

(noun). Viên thuốc

Ex: Take three pills daily after meals.

possibility

(noun). khả năng, sự có thể

Ex: There is a real possibility of war.

resistant

(adjective). Kháng lại

Ex: Mosquitoes are becoming resistant to insecticides.

suspect

(verb). nghi ngờ

Ex: She had no reason to suspect that Anna had not been telling the truth.

swallow

(verb). nuốt

Ex: Always chew food well before swallowing it.

trust

(noun). sự tin tưởng

Ex: Our partnership is based on trust.

medicine

(noun). Thuốc

Ex: She gave me a dose of cough medicine.

aware

(adjective). Có nhận thức

Ex: They suddenly became aware of people looking at them.

complex

(adjective). Phức tạp

Ex: We live in an increasingly complex world.

cough

(noun). ho

Ex: She gave a little cough to attract my attention.

manufacturer

(noun). nhà sản xuất

Ex: Always follow the manufacturer's instructions.

situation

(noun). tình huống

Ex: There is no doubt that the current situation is very serious.

ward

(noun). phòng bệnh

Ex: He worked as a nurse on the children's ward.

authority

(noun). Người có thẩm quyền

Ex: The health authorities are investigating the problem.

context

(noun). Bối cảnh

Ex: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.

govern

(verb). cai trị, quản lý

Ex: The country is governed by elected representatives of the people.

handle

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: A new man was appointed to handle the crisis.

individual

(adjective). cá nhân

Ex: We interviewed each individual member of the community.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.

pharmacist

(noun). dược sĩ; người bán dược phẩm

Ex: We had to wait for the pharmacist to make up her prescription.

practical

(adjective). Thực tiễn

Ex: He offered her some practical advice.

properly

(adverb). Đúng cách

Ex: How much money do we need to do the job properly?

regulatory

(adjective). thuộc về quản lí, thuộc về điều tiết

Ex: The deal is subject to regulatory approval.

requirement

(noun). yêu cầu

Ex: All products can be customized to suit your specific requirements.

resource

(noun). Nguồn tài nguyên

Ex: They promote the use of renewable resources like soybean oil.

skeptical

(adjective). hoài nghi, ngờ vực

Ex: I am skeptical about his chances of winning.

an awful lot of

(adverb). rất nhiều

Ex: It's going to cost an awful lot of money.

company

(noun). công ty

Ex: It is the world's largest software company.

leaflet

(noun). tờ rơi

Ex: We picked up a few leaflets on local places of interest.

order

(noun). thứ tự; trật tự

Ex: Let's take the problems in a different order.

patient

(noun). Bệnh nhân

Ex: Hospitals are treating more patients than ever before.

present

(verb). đưa ra, bày ra

Ex: Are you presenting a paper at the conference?

brief

(noun). Bản tóm tắt, bản toát yếu

Ex: I was given the brief of reorganizing the department.

prepare

(verb). chuẩn bị

Ex: A hotel room is being prepared for them.

proposal

(noun). đề nghị

Ex: His proposal that the system should be changed was rejected.

summary

(noun). bản tóm tắt

Ex: A summary begins with an introductory sentence that states the text's title

agency

(noun). cơ quan, sở, hãng, đại lý

Ex: She works for an advertising agency.

come up with

(verb). nghĩ ra, nảy ra

Ex: She came up with a new idea for increasing sales.

commission

(verb). ủy nhiệm, ủy thác

Ex: The survey on consumer taste was commissioned by local stores.

external

(adjective). bên ngoài

Ex: Many external influences can affect your state of mind.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể, có lẽ

Ex: This is perhaps his best novel to date.

consumer

(noun). Người tiêu dùng

Ex: Health-conscious consumers want more information about the food they buy.

finally

(adverb). Cuối cùng, sau cùng

Ex: The performance finally started half an hour late.

test

(verb). kiểm nghiệm

Ex: The software has been tested for viruses.

whittle down

(verb). làm giảm

Ex: I finally managed to whittle down the names on the list to only five.

contrast

(noun). Sự tương phản

Ex: The flowers provide a contrast with the dark background.

create

(verb). tạo nên, tạo ra

Ex: Scientists disagree about how the universe was created.

prescription

(noun). đơn thuốc

Ex: Then I went to attend to my patients and wrote prescriptions and directions for their ailments.

engineer

(noun). kĩ sư

Ex: We worked with a team of scientists and engineers.

produce

(verb). sản xuất

Ex: Our company mainly produces goods for export.

subject to

(verb). phải chịu, phải bị

Ex: The city was subjected to heavy bombing.

error

(noun). lỗi

Ex: A simple error of judgement meant that there was not enough food to go around.

highlight

(verb). nhấn mạnh

Ex: This study highlights the fact that couples are keen to assist others.

obvious

(adjective). Hiển nhiên

Ex: He agreed with obvious pleasure.

potential

(noun). Tiềm năng, triển vọng

Ex: The European marketplace offers excellent potential for increasing sales.

solution

(noun). Giải pháp

Ex: Attempts to find a solution have failed.

argument

(noun). lý lẽ, lý luận

Ex: Having heard both sides of the argument, the court will make a decision.

attention

(noun). Sự chú ý

Ex: An article in the newspaper caught my attention.

choice

(noun). sự lựa chọn

Ex: There is a wide range of choices open to you.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

due to

(preposition). vì

Ex: A lot of her unhappiness is due to boredom.

mention

(verb). nhắc đến, đề cập

Ex: I promised never to mention the incident again.

overcome

(verb). Vượt qua

Ex: She overcame injury to win the Olympic gold medal.

progress

(noun). tiến triển

Ex: James is making steady progress in his recovery.

prohibitive

(adjective). quá cao

Ex: The price of property in the city is prohibitive.

remove

(verb). loại bỏ

Ex: Remove the pan from the heat and continue to stir the sauce.

sufferer

(noun). người hứng chịu, người chịu đựng

Ex: Local services provide residential care for dementia sufferers.
